subject: Dedicated GPU procurement — tiered vendor plan & cloud fallback
messages:
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Matthews <caroline@hypercloud.com>, procurement@acme.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated GPU procurement — tiered vendor plan & cloud fallback

Caroline / ACME procurement team,

Thanks for joining the call this morning. Per our conversation, ACME is targeting an initial Dedicated pool of 120 A100-equivalent slots for a Q4 onramp, with an expected steady-state of ~320 slots by month three. We need to firm up vendor timelines and an ordered fallback plan (cloud bursting + OEM staging) in case hardware delivery slips.

High-level asks:
- Caroline: can you attach the tiered quote and lead-time windows you mentioned (we discussed preferred slot windows and expedited options)?
- ACME procurement: confirm required contract milestones that will authorize hardware purchase (PO date / payment milestones).
- Lauren / Karthik (internal): please sketch a staged capacity schedule that maps to deal milestones and call out where cloud capacity should kick in.

Target next step: agree on a "staged procurement plan" by end of week (Fri 10/10) that spells out: slot allocations by tranche, committed ship windows, and cloud fallback triggers.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none in this message (awaiting vendor quote)

From: Caroline Matthews <caroline@hypercloud.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, ACME AI Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU procurement — tiered vendor plan & cloud fallback

Sergio / team,

Thanks for the summary. Attached are two items: our tiered quote (hypercloud_quote_Q3.pdf) and a lead-time/slot availability spreadsheet (omentech_slot_summary.xlsx) showing the earliest ship weeks for the SKUs we discussed. Quick notes:
- We can hold a tranche of 80 slots in the November ship window if ACME signs a two-week PO hold by 10/15; additional 40 slots can be committed for December with an expedited fee.
- OEM partner (OmenTech) has a tentative manufacturing slot in late December — that one is not firm until a 30% deposit is scheduled.
- Cloud fallback: we propose a month-to-month burst pool that mirrors the committed tranche sizes; estimate for 120-slot burst is ~1.8x hosted cost for the first 30 days.

I've included Jeffrey from OmenTech on the thread to confirm manufacturing slots and the deposit schedule.

Regards,
Caroline Matthews
Enterprise Sales — HyperCloud
caroline@hypercloud.com
Attachments: hypercloud_quote_Q3.pdf, omentech_slot_summary.xlsx

Sergio / Caroline / ACME,

Thanks Caroline, the attached slot summary is helpful. I drafted a short Mutual Action Plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_ACME.docx) that maps the deal milestones to procurement triggers and our operational handoffs. Key clarifications we need from ACME procurement:
- PO milestone that releases tranche 1 (we propose PO1 = authorization to order 80 slots).
- Timing tolerance for tranche 2 (if tranche 2 drops > 21 days from expected ship window, we default to cloud burst until hardware arrives).
- Acceptance criteria: on-prem validation window (3 business days) before counting slots as live.

Internal ask (Karthik): can you outline the staged capacity schedule (slot counts by week) and include a simple cost delta between immediate cloud burst vs wait-for-hardware for first 60 days? That will help ACME decide deposit vs short-term cloud.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai
Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_ACME.docx

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Caroline Matthews <caroline@hypercloud.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Oct 2025 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU procurement — tiered vendor plan & cloud fallback

Sergio / Lauren / Caroline,

Draft staged capacity schedule (high level):
- Tranche A (Nov target): 80 slots — onboard and validate weeks 1–2 of Nov; if ship delayed > 14 days, enable Cloud Burst A (80 slots) until hardware arrives.
- Tranche B (Dec target): 40 slots — ship window mid-Dec; deposit required to lock manufacturing slot.
- Tranche C (Jan target): ramp to 320 steady-state by end of Jan via additional procurements + scaling our Dedicated pool.

Estimated cost delta (first 60 days):
- Cloud burst (80 slots) estimated incremental hosted spend: ~$120k — vs expedited OEM fee for securing Dec tranche: ~$85k (deposit + expedite).

Operational notes:
- We should stagger delivery windows across two OEM batches to reduce single-point manufacturing risk.
- Recommend an explicit fallback trigger: if manufacturing lead time slips beyond 21 days vs committed window, we automatically enable cloud burst for the affected tranche and notify ACME procurement/ops.

I'll produce a short spreadsheet with week-by-week slot counts and cost comparisons by EOD Thurs.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Infra Partnerships — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

From: Jeffrey Li <jeffrey.li@omentech.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Caroline Matthews <caroline@hypercloud.com>
Cc: ACME AI Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU procurement — tiered vendor plan & cloud fallback

Sergio / Caroline / ACME team,

Confirming OmenTech can hold a tentative manufacturing slot in the week of 12/15 for the Dec tranche contingent on a 30% deposit by 10/20. Attached is the slot summary (we mirrored HyperCloud's sheet and added our manufacturing constraints). If ACME elects to deposit, we will issue a formal proforma and follow up with a DocuSign for the deposit schedule: https://docusign.com/req/abc123-DEAL-8821

If deposit is not provided by 10/20, that week becomes available to other customers and our next available lead time moves to late Jan. For the Nov tranche, we can prioritize a limited expedited build but there is a 2–3 week expedite premium.

Next steps I propose:
- ACME confirms PO1 (authorization to order 80 slots) and whether they will provide a 30% deposit for Dec tranche by 10/15.
- Redwood (Sergio + Karthik) provide the week-by-week staging spreadsheet and a decision matrix (cloud burst vs deposit) by EOD Thurs.

Thanks,
Jeffrey Li
Sales Ops — OmenTech
jeffrey.li@omentech.com
Attachments: omentech_slot_summary.xlsx
